description:
Player HQ 1.7.3
Player HQ Download Github

Description:
The Player HQ is meant to be a base of operation for the player to set up and build apond, assisting them in their journey thought the sector, it basic function is that of a storage place and it is up to the player to decide what functionalities they want to add to it by adding models to the station, how much the station improves is completely up to the player.

Allows the player chose where to build a station around a planet or in a asteroid field/belt (hotbar ability)
It's basic function is that of an abandoned station to store ships and items. (can't be attacked or raided and doesn't count as a colony)
If the player chooses to upgrade the station further it will add more functions to it.
Included but not limited to Mining, Manufacturing and even ship/weapon production.
Base Starsector assets where used, so no dependence are needed.

Preview Image

Change Logs/Bugs
Known Bugs
Ships produced by the HQ in previous versions would produce variants with equipment, this was fixed in the 1.7 version but ships that where produced by the HQ before 1.7 will be buggy when used in fleets for the HQ, I recommend selling them or using them your self but not in crewing the fleets.

1.7.3 Change Log
Fixed fleets spawning with 0% CR and dying to accidents. (This one was frustrating to fix but it turned out it was because they where being copied at 0% CR from storage and the CR top up wasn't having an effect on stored ships so now it applies after the copy.)

Fixed resupply and courier fleets not finding you in system, they will now travel to your current location when they enter the system, if you are not there when they get there they will then head to your current location, this will repeat until they find you.

Patrol Fleet
Removed 2 of the Patrol fleets and added a upgrade to unlock a second one, all patrol fleets will be depsawned and ships will be refunded to you.
Reworked the patrol fleet's mechanics, You now need 1 capital, 1 cruiser, 1 destroyer and 1 frigate, the fleet will consist of 1 capital, 4 cruisers, 6 destroyers and 12 frigates, C/D/F will be cloned off the ships you gave them to fill in the other slots, it will cost you the sum total of the ship and it's equipment, when decrewing the bays it will give you back the original ships and the full credit.

Fusion Lamps in the Bio-Dome and Resort require Volatiles as a upkeep, 2 for the Resort and 4 for the Bio-Dome.

Added a inventory for the Expedition's loot so it doesn't get lost in the station's main inventory and is easier to manage.

Reworked all costs of modules and upgrades.

1.7.2 Change Log
Mining and Salvage fleets where moved to the Fleet HQ but still require the Material Acquisition Hub to be build.

Reworked the cost of the Player HQ and all the modals.

The Manufactorium now produces all the items with out special items at 2x the cost, only exception to this is Heavy Armaments, Domestic/Luxury Goods which are 3x standard, 2x with corrupted and 1x with pristine and only produce a max of 50 per month.

Fixed a bug where the resupply and courier fleet would not head to you once in system making it where you had to find it, now it will travel to you in system as well.
Courier fleet can now have up to 5 freighters.

Cleaned up the main menu and added a line for what is being produced atm.

Bio-Dome no longer requires a Fusion Lamp to build but production is limited, added a new upgrade that adds the Fusion lamp to improve production, Fusion Lamp and Soil Nanites upgrades will return it to the old output.

1.7.0/1 Change Logs
(1.7.1)
Added all the changes that where suppose to be in the previous patches, messed up and was working on two different versions of the game.

Removed 2 Mining Fleets and added 2 Salvage Fleets to the MAH, They will launch and search for debris fields and derelict ships, they will ignore ships with guards.

Added a Winter Resort to the Resort.
VR Suites now give a bonus % based off the hazard rating of the planet over 100%.
Beach Resort now gives a bonus for cold, very cold and planets with no atmosphere that are also cold.
Winter Resort give bonuses to hot and very hot planets.

Fixed where you can now produce fighters at the HQ.

Reworked the Courier's mechanic. (Forgot to actually add it but made a better version.)
Couriers will now return to the HQ as soon as the screen is closed.
There is now a Charter option on the main menu that allows you to set supply colonies and request colonies for the courier.

If the player has the automated ship skill they can use automated ships in the patrol HQ.

Added a Shopping List feature that allows your trade ship to buy equipment and ships from the market they are visiting.

1.6.3 Change Logs
Fixed a bug where the custom order screen would close once opening when used from the intel screen.

Fixed the Exchange offering things it shouldn't offer for both the weapons and the ship side.

Fixed Expeditions returning with things they shouldn't like models of ships and stations.

Reworked the mining fleets, they now launch when ready, they have a 4 day cooldown after each mining trip, they will now travel to a planet and mine, each day they add to the fleets total cargo hold and when full will return to the station, if the station's hold is full of the resources the system offers the fleets will hold off on launching until the hold goes lower then 8,000.

1.6.2 Change Logs
Added the ability to pause production in the Manufactorium.

Cleaned up text to make everything as clean and understandable as possible.

Removed the ability to use Capitals in the Resupply/Trade/Courier/Mining fleets. (Before updating make sure to remove any Capitals)

Added 2 lines in the income screen under player hq that shows the upkeep for marines and crew in the HQ.

1.6.1 Change Logs
Removed 2 Courier fleets and added a Trade Fleet.
Trade fleets consist of up to 10 freighters and 2 tankers, will load up excess resources and sell them to friendly markets but are less efficient then trading your self. (Limited to Frigates, Destroyers and Cruisers only.)

Renamed the Call Resupply fleet ability to Call Fleet that will open a menu that will allow you to pick between a Resupply Fleet and A Courier Fleet
The courier fleet will act like the resupply fleet but instead take items from you and ferry them to the HQ

Strategic Assembly will now start with 500,000 production credit limit and the Nanoforge will give a bonus of 100,000 for a Corrupted and 250,000 for a pristine, Gamma cores give a bonus of 75,000, Beta of 150,000 and Alpha 250,000 along with their other bonuses.

Added ships to the exchange and added the ability to store ships in the Agora for selling.

Expedition Fleets now will require 2 tankers and will leave the system targeting the nearest highest tier ruin planet with in 10ly of the HQ.

Added a button under the HQ report that allows you to place orders when not near the station.

1.6 Change Logs
Forgot to track changes so I might of missed some

Friendly stations in the system will now send out a SOS that will be added to a list, any active patrol fleets will book it to that station to help with defense before moving on to the next station that needs help, when the list is clear fleet will return to normal

Add different options to dedicated AI system, now offering 3 tires, Gamma, Beta and Alpha each offering a better reduction and credit pool increase per month.
Changed the bonuses for the corrupt and pristine forge in the strategic assembly and giving them a bonus to production pool income per month.

Made it where mining fleets will now target planets with resources that the HQ needs the most.

I know I fixed a few bugs but can't remember what they where. (Sorry)

Thinking of redoing the fleets but need your opinions, Was thinking of removing a Patrol fleet and turning it into a Strike Fleet that you can order to attack something and a Grand Defender Fleet that will allow you to build only 1 patrol fleet but have up to 30 ships making it more of a boss fleet.
Was thinking of removing 2 courier fleets as I personally don't often use more then two anyway but add a Trade Fleet that will trade excess wares from the station for you.
Was thinking of making the Expedition Fleets to be allowed to go to different systems with a increased chance of finding loot but also require you to fund the expeditions with credits, supplies and fuel. (Let me know what you think)

1.5 Change Logs
Forgot to add the fix for the fleets dying due to low CR, it's in this version now.

Fixed fleets being spawned as mothballed.

Fixed a bug where it would say it build the module but when you left the interaction screen it would go back to showing not being installed.

Added the HQ to a single line under the fleet in the income screen.

cleaned up text and made it more understandable.

Added a line to the intel report for Mining Fleets and what they brought back that month.

Added version checker support.(Actually this time, will fix change log when I have the time)

1.4 Change Logs
Fixed a bug where fleets where stuck at 0% CR and dying.

Added support for mods that add mining ships, added carriers and drone tenders to the list of acceptable ships, mining/carrier/drone tenders get a 2x mining power bonus.
(Courier/Resupply fleets can also use modded ships.)

Fixed a bug where if the fleet was destroyed and you uninstalled the bay you'd not get any ships back.

1.3 Change Logs
Military Paradigm:
Reworked the Expedition HQ now named Fleet HQ with 3 different fleet types, Expedition, Logistics and Patrol.
Expedition works like it use to, Patrol allows you to build custom fleets to patrol the sector by building the ships and then adding them to the fleet, Logistics has two different things, Resupply Bay and Courier bays, Resupply allows you to field a fleet that when you use the ability it will travel to your location and allow you to get supplies as long as you have them in your HQ, the courier fleets will allow you to transport stuff between your colonies and the HQ.
Fleets produced by the Patrol aren't lost when destroyed, when fully destroyed it will take a full month for them to redeploy, 3 days for each frigate replaced, 6 for destroyers, 10 for cruisers and 16 for capitals.
To build Expedition fleets, there will need to be a planet with ruins on them in the system.
Added the ability to "inject" credits into the custom production but at 10x the price.

Manufactorium:
In the Manufactorium you can now pick between a Corrupt and Pristine, the corrupt doubles the cost of production.
Removed the Fusion Core(remove before updating.) and gave the bonuses to Catalytic Core.

Materials Acquisition Hub:
Reworked the Materials Acquisition Hub, removed the installable items, so remove them before updating, reduced the mining scope to only the planet/belt the station is located at and added mining fleets.
Improved resource harvest % from 15% to 20%

1.2 Change Logs
Cleaned up info text, fixed typos and removed personal notes.

Added fuel production via the installation of a Synchrotron Core.

Reduced the Bio-Dome output some more, now 600 Food and 300 Organics, Soil Nanites now give a flat 200 more of each when installed.

Removed the Combat Drone Replicator station upgrade(Make sure to uninstall it before updating) and now the colony gets a 0.50x bonus to defense and +1 Stability if you build the Military Hub.

Added a 500 Crew cost for the Resort.

Got the intel report to look cleaner and be more useful.

Training Expeditions now orbit for 8 days before moving on to a new planet and will prioritize planets with ruins first.

Added the ability to pick what ships you want to crew the bays with in the Expedition HQ

Added a Market Place upgrade the station upgrades, when build it will unlock a market that will sell weapons, wings and rarely blueprints and hullmods, it will allow you to sell your excess equipment, hullmods and blueprints but a random number will be picked between 0 and 1,000,000 and that is the amount that be able to be sold that month, there is a second inventory of the station where you place your items you want to sell and the pricey ones will be sold first, if you buy anything off the market it will be added to the total amount.

Working on a blacklist for things that mods add that shouldn't be in the market place.

Working on a new upgrade that will allow you to request a fleet via a ability to get Supplies, Crew and Fuel.

Will add mod support for items if there is a request for them.

1.1 Change Logs
Did general clean up of descriptions and info text.

Fixed not getting the ability when adding mod to existing save, tested it even with removing the mod, remember when removing to make sure to dismantle the station before saving and removing the mod.

Fixed the High tech version needing a gamma and the Low tech needing a beta. (should of been the other way around)

Added a accessibility mechanic to the station that starts at 25% meaning you only earn 25% of the credits the Resort would be earning, at 100% you will gain the full amount of credits for the Resort and any % over that will give you a bonus, Added Station Upgrades to improve accessibility.
(The player skill Industrial Planning will now give a 15% accessibility bonus to the station.)

Added a new upgrade to the Military Paradigm that requires you to build it with ships that will let your crew and marines go on expeditions. (4 bays in total)
Fleets will actually spawn from your station using the ships you gave them that can not be attack and will go around the system orbiting planets for a while before returning to the station, if the planet has ruins there is a chance that they will return with weapons/wings/blueprints/special items and even ships.
(If the player has the skill Salvaging then there will be a improved chance to find rare stuff.)

Added info showing cost and production for things in the Manufactorium.

Reduced the Bio-Sphere as I found it was rivaling the production of a planet.

Install Nanoforge in the Strategic Assembly now lets you pick between corrupt and pristine instead of auto picking.

Added a better intel report under the "Personal" tab of the intel screen telling you where the station is and what it produced last month as well.

Marine XP gained from them training at the station will now be transferred to your fleet. (sense they are training under your style of leadership)

Added asteroid belts to the Materials Acquisition Hub, each belt now gives ore, rare ore and volatiles.

releases.changelogNotes:
Fixed fleets spawning with 0% CR and dying to accidents. (This one was frustrating to fix but it turned out it was because they where being copied at 0% CR from storage and the CR top up wasn't having an effect on stored ships so now it applies after the copy.)

Fixed resupply and courier fleets not finding you in system, they will now travel to your current location when they enter the system, if you are not there when they get there they will then head to your current location, this will repeat until they find you.

Patrol Fleet
Removed 2 of the Patrol fleets and added a upgrade to unlock a second one, all patrol fleets will be depsawned and ships will be refunded to you.
Reworked the patrol fleet's mechanics, You now need 1 capital, 1 cruiser, 1 destroyer and 1 frigate, the fleet will consist of 1 capital, 4 cruisers, 6 destroyers and 12 frigates, C/D/F will be cloned off the ships you gave them to fill in the other slots, it will cost you the sum total of the ship and it's equipment, when decrewing the bays it will give you back the original ships and the full credit.

Fusion Lamps in the Bio-Dome and Resort require Volatiles as a upkeep, 2 for the Resort and 4 for the Bio-Dome.

Added a inventory for the Expedition's loot so it doesn't get lost in the station's main inventory and is easier to manage.

Reworked all costs of modules and upgrades.

Mining and Salvage fleets where moved to the Fleet HQ but still require the Material Acquisition Hub to be build.

Reworked the cost of the Player HQ and all the modals.

The Manufactorium now produces all the items with out special items at 2x the cost, only exception to this is Heavy Armaments, Domestic/Luxury Goods which are 3x standard, 2x with corrupted and 1x with pristine and only produce a max of 50 per month.

Fixed a bug where the resupply and courier fleet would not head to you once in system making it where you had to find it, now it will travel to you in system as well.
Courier fleet can now have up to 5 freighters.

Cleaned up the main menu and added a line for what is being produced atm.

Bio-Dome no longer requires a Fusion Lamp to build but production is limited, added a new upgrade that adds the Fusion lamp to improve production, Fusion Lamp and Soil Nanites upgrades will return it to the old output.

Added all the changes that where suppose to be in the previous patches, messed up and was working on two different versions of the game.

Removed 2 Mining Fleets and added 2 Salvage Fleets to the MAH, They will launch and search for debris fields and derelict ships, they will ignore ships with guards.

Added a Winter Resort to the Resort.
VR Suites now give a bonus % based off the hazard rating of the planet over 100%.
Beach Resort now gives a bonus for cold, very cold and planets with no atmosphere that are also cold.
Winter Resort give bonuses to hot and very hot planets.

Fixed where you can now produce fighters at the HQ.

Reworked the Courier's mechanic. (Forgot to actually add it but made a better version.)
Couriers will now return to the HQ as soon as the screen is closed.
There is now a Charter option on the main menu that allows you to set supply colonies and request colonies for the courier.

If the player has the automated ship skill they can use automated ships in the patrol HQ.

Added a Shopping List feature that allows your trade ship to buy equipment and ships from the market they are visiting.

Removed 2 Mining Fleets and added 2 Salvage Fleets to the MAH, They will launch and search for debris fields and derelict ships, they will ignore ships with guards.

Added a Winter Resort to the Resort.
VR Suites now give a bonus % based off the hazard rating of the planet over 100%.
Beach Resort now gives a bonus for cold, very cold and planets with no atmosphere that are also cold.
Winter Resort give bonuses to hot and very hot planets.

Fixed where you can now produce fighters at the HQ.

Reworked the Courier's mechanic. (Forgot to actually add it but made a better version.)
Couriers will now return to the HQ as soon as the screen is closed.
There is now a Charter option on the main menu that allows you to set supply colonies and request colonies for the courier.

If the player has the automated ship skill they can use automated ships in the patrol HQ.

Added a Shopping List feature that allows your trade ship to buy equipment and ships from the market they are visiting.

Fixed a bug where the custom order screen would close once opening when used from the intel screen.

Fixed the Exchange offering things it shouldn't offer for both the weapons and the ship side.

Fixed Expeditions returning with things they shouldn't like models of ships and stations.

Reworked the mining fleets, they now launch when ready, they have a 4 day cooldown after each mining trip, they will now travel to a planet and mine, each day they add to the fleets total cargo hold and when full will return to the station, if the station's hold is full of the resources the system offers the fleets will hold off on launching until the hold goes lower then 8,000.

Added the ability to pause production in the Manufactorium.

Cleaned up text to make everything as clean and understandable as possible.

Removed the ability to use Capitals in the Resupply/Trade/Courier/Mining fleets. (Before updating make sure to remove any Capitals)

Added 2 lines in the income screen under player hq that shows the upkeep for marines and crew in the HQ.
releases.updateCompatibilityText: Removed the ability to use Capitals in the Resupply/Trade/Courier/Mining fleets. (Before updating make sure to remove any Capitals)

releases.changelogNotes:
Removed 2 Courier fleets and added a Trade Fleet.
Trade fleets consist of up to 10 freighters and 2 tankers, will load up excess resources and sell them to friendly markets but are less efficient then trading your self. (Limited to Frigates, Destroyers and Cruisers only.)

Renamed the Call Resupply fleet ability to Call Fleet that will open a menu that will allow you to pick between a Resupply Fleet and A Courier Fleet
The courier fleet will act like the resupply fleet but instead take items from you and ferry them to the HQ

Strategic Assembly will now start with 500,000 production credit limit and the Nanoforge will give a bonus of 100,000 for a Corrupted and 250,000 for a pristine, Gamma cores give a bonus of 75,000, Beta of 150,000 and Alpha 250,000 along with their other bonuses.

Added ships to the exchange and added the ability to store ships in the Agora for selling.

Expedition Fleets now will require 2 tankers and will leave the system targeting the nearest highest tier ruin planet with in 10ly of the HQ.

Added a button under the HQ report that allows you to place orders when not near the station.

Forgot to track changes so I might of missed some

Friendly stations in the system will now send out a SOS that will be added to a list, any active patrol fleets will book it to that station to help with defense before moving on to the next station that needs help, when the list is clear fleet will return to normal

Add different options to dedicated AI system, now offering 3 tires, Gamma, Beta and Alpha each offering a better reduction and credit pool increase per month.
Changed the bonuses for the corrupt and pristine forge in the strategic assembly and giving them a bonus to production pool income per month.

Made it where mining fleets will now target planets with resources that the HQ needs the most.

I know I fixed a few bugs but can't remember what they where. (Sorry)

Thinking of redoing the fleets but need your opinions, Was thinking of removing a Patrol fleet and turning it into a Strike Fleet that you can order to attack something and a Grand Defender Fleet that will allow you to build only 1 patrol fleet but have up to 30 ships making it more of a boss fleet.
Was thinking of removing 2 courier fleets as I personally don't often use more then two anyway but add a Trade Fleet that will trade excess wares from the station for you.
Was thinking of making the Expedition Fleets to be allowed to go to different systems with a increased chance of finding loot but also require you to fund the expeditions with credits, supplies and fuel. (Let me know what you think)

Forgot to add the fix for the fleets dying due to low CR, it's in this version now.

Fixed fleets being spawned as mothballed.

Fixed a bug where it would say it build the module but when you left the interaction screen it would go back to showing not being installed.

Added the HQ to a single line under the fleet in the income screen.

cleaned up text and made it more understandable.

Added a line to the intel report for Mining Fleets and what they brought back that month.

Added version checker support.(Actually this time, will fix change log when I have the time)

Added version checker support.

Fixed a bug where fleets where stuck at 0% CR and dying.

Added support for mods that add mining ships, added carriers and drone tenders to the list of acceptable ships, mining/carrier/drone tenders get a 2x mining power bonus.
(Courier/Resupply fleets can also use modded ships.)

Fixed a bug where if the fleet was destroyed and you uninstalled the bay you'd not get any ships back.

Cleaned up info text, fixed typos and removed personal notes.

Added fuel production via the installation of a Synchrotron Core.

Reduced the Bio-Dome output some more, now 600 Food and 300 Organics, Soil Nanites now give a flat 200 more of each when installed.

Removed the Combat Drone Replicator station upgrade(Make sure to uninstall it before updating) and now the colony gets a 0.50x bonus to defense and +1 Stability if you build the Military Hub.

Added a 500 Crew cost for the Resort.

Got the intel report to look cleaner and be more useful.

Training Expeditions now orbit for 8 days before moving on to a new planet and will prioritize planets with ruins first.

Added the ability to pick what ships you want to crew the bays with in the Expedition HQ

Added a Market Place upgrade the station upgrades, when build it will unlock a market that will sell weapons, wings and rarely blueprints and hullmods, it will allow you to sell your excess equipment, hullmods and blueprints but a random number will be picked between 0 and 1,000,000 and that is the amount that be able to be sold that month, there is a second inventory of the station where you place your items you want to sell and the pricey ones will be sold first, if you buy anything off the market it will be added to the total amount.

Working on a blacklist for things that mods add that shouldn't be in the market place.

Working on a new upgrade that will allow you to request a fleet via a ability to get Supplies, Crew and Fuel.

Will add mod support for items if there is a request for them.
releases.updateCompatibilityText: Removed the Combat Drone Replicator station upgrade(Make sure to uninstall it before updating) and now the colony gets a 0.50x bonus to defense and +1 Stability if you build the Military Hub.

releases.changelogNotes:
Did general clean up of descriptions and info text.

Fixed not getting the ability when adding mod to existing save, tested it even with removing the mod, remember when removing to make sure to dismantle the station before saving and removing the mod.

Fixed the High tech version needing a beta and the Low tech needing a Gamma. (should of been the other way around)

Added a accessibility mechanic to the station that starts at 25% meaning you only earn 25% of the credits the Resort would be earning, at 100% you will gain the full amount of credits for the Resort and any % over that will give you a bonus, Added Station Upgrades to improve accessibility.
(The player skill Industrial Planning will now give a 15% accessibility bonus to the station.)

Added a new upgrade to the Military Paradigm that requires you to build it with ships that will let your crew and marines go on expeditions. (4 bays in total)
Fleets will actually spawn from your station using the ships you gave them that can not be attack and will go around the system orbiting planets for a while before returning to the station, if the planet has ruins there is a chance that they will return with weapons/wings/blueprints/special items and even ships.
(If the player has the skill Salvaging then there will be a improved chance to find rare stuff.)

Added info showing cost and production for things in the Manufactorium.

Reduced the Bio-Sphere as I found it was rivaling the production of a planet.

Install Nanoforge in the Strategic Assembly now lets you pick between corrupt and pristine instead of auto picking.

Added a better intel report under the "Personal" tab of the intel screen telling you where the station is and what it produced last month as well.

Marine XP gained from them training at the station will now be transferred to your fleet. (sense they are training under your style of leadership)

Added asteroid belts to the Materials Acquisition Hub, each belt now gives ore, rare ore and volatiles.
